# Vendored Fortran libraries

Facsimile vendors release snapshots of its small FortranGoingOnForty
dependencies so Make, fpm, Homebrew, and source-tarball builds are
network-independent.

| Library | Version | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fgof-screen` | `v0.3.0` | https://github.com/FortranGoingOnForty/fgof-screen |
| `fgof-toml` | `v0.1.0` | https://github.com/FortranGoingOnForty/fgof-toml |

The upstream repositories are canonical. Update a snapshot only from a tagged
release and update this table in the same commit.
